0022600131.text: The Lakers, now 3-0 and 2-0 at home, host the 2-0 Portland Trail Blazers in their fourth game of the season, with Los Angeles on a three-game winning streak and sitting 1st in the Pacific. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though Los Angeles lost 1-2 to Portland in the 2025-26 season series, including a 132-116 loss in Portland on January 17, 2026. Adou Thiero is out for the Lakers with knee inflammation, while Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Branden Carlson (concussion) and Scoot Henderson (ankle soreness) are both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions.
